title: Ruined Temple Beacon
description: A surreal ruined stone temple complex with crumbling walls and broken stairs stands under a dark stormy sky. Multiple towering plumes of glowing blue, cyan, and green ethereal smoke rise from the ground, illuminated by a dramatic beam of purple-white light piercing through the clouds onto the cracked stone courtyard.
